Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 04-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT(ISM) Dhanbad JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 04 October 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 37,000/- plus HRA.

faq.question: Q3. What are the essential educational qualifications for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.E/M.Tech/M.S/ Integrated M.Tech or B.E/B.Tech. in relevant disciplines, or an M.Sc/M.Sc.Tech in Chemistry/Environmental Science, along with a valid GATE/CSIR-UGC NET qualification.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on their merit, followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply by sending their application via email.

faq.question: Q7. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology (Indian School of Mines) Dhanbad (IIT(ISM) Dhanbad).

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is SRDP 1320 G.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any age limit relaxations mentioned?
faq.answer: Age relaxation will be provided as per the norms of the Government of India.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) is on a contractual basis.
